# AGI.alpha v0.1.0 - first public release

2026-10-26

The first public release of the AGI system: a generative personal assistant that runs on the user's own
machine, carries a quantum-resistant identity, and keeps its own verifiable history.

## What is in this release

* **official bundle** (`bundle/official/`) - the distributable bundle, shipped in its neutral (inactive) state;
* **update pool** (`pool/`) - pills generated by all bundles, each with its signed tree head and a Merkle
  inclusion proof, behind a signed index;
* **public mirror** (`public/mirror/<tree_size>/`) - the `*.public` pill mirror at a known log head;
* **release packages** (`releases/official|custom/<date>/`) - signed zips with per-file hashes, plus
  `releases/SHA256SUMS`;
* **CI integrity job** - verifies artefact hashes, SHA256SUMS and identity hygiene on every push.

## Identity and trust (why it is shaped this way)

Post-quantum signatures (ML-DSA-65, FIPS 204), an offline owner authority, member identity rooted in a Merkle-ised private record, a bundle lattice with consumer-side policy, and an append-only RFC 9162 log.
Nothing is trusted because it arrived; it is trusted because it verifies.

## Install and verify

```
python memory/scripts/release.py verify agi-official-d-<date>.zip
python memory/scripts/repo.py verify
python memory/scripts/pool_pull.py   # (runtime command names are documented in the bundle's docs/TRUST.md)
```

## Known limitations (published on purpose)

* the owner-activation path currently needs offline material; portable identity is the subject of the
  next research cycle and will land as a separate release;
* branch protection on this host is plan-limited; integrity is enforced by pinned hashes, CI and gated pushes;
* the license has not been chosen yet - see NOTICE.md.
